places-chapel-of-the-former-hacienda-of-.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-chapel-of-the-former-hacienda-of-.story: A 161 km round trip from Rodeo - roughly 2 h 47 in the saddle. It goes by way of Architectonic ensemble of the Town of Naza, Stretch of the Camino Real between Nazas a and back through Architectonic ensemble of the Town of Naza. The highest point is about 1,800 m. The line favours views over speed.
